name: Corrupt
source:
-When you're facing a corruption, will you stop it or ignore it?-

In the near future, at the time when corruption is a new normal, Laia exploited the society and became a leader of the world's government. Amita has to travel through time to the past to stop the cause of new normal with a hope to stop corruptions to save her fragile and collapsing future.

The player will face with the real world-inspired corruption cases in Thailand and required to investigate and collect evidence to "stop or ignore" multiple corruption events. Every decisions will affect the story line and future events in the game.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/927850/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“当你面对腐败时，会阻止它还是视而不见？”

不久的未来，腐败已成为新常态。莱娅利用社会，成为世界政府的领袖。阿米塔必须穿越时间回到过去，阻止新常态的成因，希望能够终结腐败，拯救脆弱而正在崩溃的未来。

玩家将面对以泰国现实世界为灵感的腐败案件，调查并收集证据，在多个腐败事件中作出“阻止或忽视”的选择。每个决定都会影响故事线与未来事件。

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/927850/]Steam[/url]]
